correctness.rationale: For fixed c,τ>0, N≥2 and ρ=1−e^(−cN), nonnegative power-series coefficients give exact Fourier modes λ_{N,j}=N/d_N sum_{k≥0}ρ^(j+kN)/(j+kN+τ), strictly decreasing in j. Integral substitution F_a(t)=∫_0^t v^(a−1)/(1−v)dv, a=(j+τ)/N and t=ρ^N, gives F_a=−log(1−t)+1/a+O(1) uniformly including a→0, while −log(1−t)=cN−log N+O(Ne^(−cN)) and d_N=cN+O(1). Division proves λ_{N,j}=1+1/[c(j+τ)]+O(log N/N) uniformly 0≤j<N; extending Fourier diagonals by ones yields the ℓ² operator-norm limit with tail O(1/N). Log-kernel growth O(log N) off diagonal versus d_N≈cN proves coherence O(log N/N), not asymptotic tightness. Fresh independent 5-,8-,12-,16-point Fourier DFT calculations exactly matched regrouped Lerch-series eigenvalues at 65-digit precision and checked strict ordering; this tests finite cases only.
